local WORKSPACE = game.Workspace
local Obstacles = WORKSPACE:WaitForChild("Obstacles")

-- Template part
local TEMPLATE = Instance.new("Part")
TEMPLATE.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
TEMPLATE.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
TEMPLATE.Anchored = false
TEMPLATE.CanCollide = true
TEMPLATE.Name = "Obstacle"

local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1.5
local AREA_SIZE = 10
local SPAWN_HEIGHT = 15

while true do
    local obstacle = TEMPLATE:Clone()
    local x = math.random(-AREA_SIZE/2, AREA_SIZE/2)
    local z = math.random(-AREA_SIZE/2, AREA_SIZE/2)
    obstacle.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, SPAWN_HEIGHT, z)
    obstacle.Parent = Obstacles

    -- Add falling behavior
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, -20, 0)
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    bodyVelocity.Parent = obstacle

    -- Clean up after 10 seconds or when it hits the ground
    task.delay(10, function()
        if obstacle.Parent then
            obstacle:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end
